2025-yale-vs-harvard-t-shirt.tagline: Two helmets, nose to nose. Red on one side, navy on the other. Heather gray holding the line between them.
2025-yale-vs-harvard-t-shirt.story: November. The parking lots fill before sunrise, and somewhere a thermos of something warm is passed down a row of strangers who are, for one afternoon, family. I have been to rivalries on three continents. None of them has the manners of this one, or the memory. This heather gray T-shirt marks the 2025 edition of The Game: a red Harvard helmet and a navy Yale helmet, facing each other, collegiate marks standing by like seconds at a duel. Wear it to the tailgate. Wear it long after. The score is yours to remember.

baseball-left-chest-crewneck.tagline: Navy, quiet, a white YALE BASEBALL wordmark over the heart. For April afternoons that forget they are supposed to be spring.
baseball-left-chest-crewneck.story: The first warm day after a New Haven winter is never actually warm. It only promises. Players stretch on the field anyway, breath still visible, and the crack of the bat sounds louder in cold air. That is the day for this crewneck. Navy, with ribbed collar, cuffs, and waistband. A white YALE BASEBALL wordmark sits small on the left chest, the way a good team doesn't need to shout. Doubleheader. Thermos. Ninth inning, still wearing it.

basic-hoodie-big-yale.tagline: Four white letters, large enough to be seen from the far side of Cross Campus. Navy. Hood up. No further explanation required.
basic-hoodie-big-yale.story: Some garments whisper. This one states its business. Large white YALE lettering across the chest of a navy pullover hoodie, a drawstring hood for the wind that comes down Elm Street like it has somewhere to be, and a front kangaroo pocket for hands, keys, a folded problem set. I watched a student cross Old Campus in one at two in the morning, lamplight on the letters, looking entirely sure of where she was going. Perhaps she was. Perhaps it was the hoodie.

benjamin-franklin-1-4-zip.tagline: Heather gray, a stand collar, and a small Benjamin Franklin College crest in color. Belonging, worn lightly on the left side.
benjamin-franklin-1-4-zip.story: There is a particular pleasure in being from somewhere specific. Not merely Yale, but one courtyard of it, one dining hall, one set of stairs you could climb in the dark. This quarter-zip says so, discreetly. Heather gray, with a stand collar that turns up against a sharp morning, ribbed cuffs and hem, and a small multicolor Benjamin Franklin College crest with the college name on the left chest. Zip it to the chin for the walk to class. Unzip it at the seminar table. Let someone ask.

benjamin-franklin-fleece-jacket.tagline: Light gray fleece, a dark gray zipper running the full length, and a small Benjamin Franklin crest. October, handled.
benjamin-franklin-fleece-jacket.story: October in New Haven arrives in stages. First the light changes. Then the leaves. Then, one morning, you reach for something more than a shirt and less than a coat. This is that something. A light gray heathered fleece jacket with a full-length dark gray zipper, a stand collar, and zippered hand pockets that keep your hands and your ID card where they belong. On the left chest, a small multicolor Benjamin Franklin crest with text. A college you can carry with you. Across the street, or across the world.

benjamin-franklin-t-shirt.tagline: A T-shirt for Benjamin Franklin College. Your college, your courtyard, your people, carried into ordinary days.
benjamin-franklin-t-shirt.story: Every residential college is a small country with its own customs. Its own late-night snack line. Its own arguments about which courtyard is best, conducted at volume, never settled. This T-shirt belongs to Benjamin Franklin College and to the people who call it home. It is the shirt for moving-in day, for the intramural game nobody trained for, for the sleepy walk to breakfast. Simple. Loyal. The kind of thing you will find in a drawer twenty years on and keep anyway.

berkeley-1-4-zip.tagline: A red Berkeley shield on heather gray. Stand collar up, the Cross Campus wind politely refused.
berkeley-1-4-zip.story: I have always admired red used sparingly. A single scarf in a gray city. A lantern on a dark quay. Here it is a red Berkeley shield crest, with Berkeley text, set on the left chest of a heather gray quarter-zip pullover. The stand collar rises when the wind does. Ribbed cuffs and hem hold steady through lectures, libraries, and long dinners that turn into longer conversations. It is not loud. It is certain. Rather like the people who wear it.

berkeley-sweater-fleece-jacket.tagline: A sweater fleece jacket for Berkeley College. Something to reach for when the evening turns and the conversation doesn't end.
berkeley-sweater-fleece-jacket.story: The best conversations at college happen after the official ones. Outside the dining hall, someone says one more thing, and suddenly it is dark and nobody has moved. You want a jacket for that. This sweater fleece jacket is made for Berkeley College people and the hours they keep. Throw it on for the walk home along a lamplit path. Leave it on the back of a chair in the library. Lend it, and hope it comes back. It usually does, eventually, with stories.

big-yale-tri-blend-t-shirt.tagline: Dusty coral. A large white YALE across the chest. The color of a late summer evening that refuses to end.
big-yale-tri-blend-t-shirt.story: Navy is the obvious answer. Sometimes the obvious answer is not the interesting one. This tri-blend T-shirt comes in dusty coral, a color I first noticed on a faded harbor door somewhere on the coast, the paint softened by years of salt and sun. Across the chest, a large white YALE wordmark. Wear it to the first week of classes, when the air is still warm and the reading list is still optimistic. Wear it on a walk along Long Wharf. Let navy have the rest of the year.

boola-boola-t-shirt.tagline: BOOLA BOOLA in distressed white and gray bubble letters on navy. A cheer you can wear without clearing your throat.
boola-boola-t-shirt.story: Some words are not meant to be translated. They are meant to be sung, badly, by a crowd in the Yale Bowl with the light going amber. Boola Boola is one of those words. Here it appears twice, in bold bubble letters of white and gray, distressed as though it has already survived a few seasons of celebration, centered on the chest of a navy short-sleeve T-shirt. You will not need to know all the lyrics. Nobody does. You will only need to mean it.

branford-1-4-zip.tagline: Heather gray quarter-zip, a multicolor Branford College crest on the left chest. For courtyards, and the people who linger in them.
branford-1-4-zip.story: There are courtyards at Yale where time slows a little. Ivy on stone. Someone practicing an instrument behind an open window. A bench that has heard every kind of confession. This quarter-zip is for Branford College, and it carries the college crest in full color on the left chest: greens and yellows and blues against heather gray. Stand collar. Ribbed cuffs and hem. Wear it for the first chill of the fall term, and keep wearing it until spring finds its way back.

brooks-brothers-bomber-jacket-yale.tagline: A dark navy Brooks Brothers bomber, white YALE on the left chest. Elegant enough for dinner on Chapel Street, ready for the Bowl.
brooks-brothers-bomber-jacket-yale.story: The bomber jacket has always belonged to people going somewhere. Airfields. Train platforms. Late flights into cities with unfamiliar alphabets. This one is going to New Haven, and it has dressed accordingly. Dark navy, full zip, a stand collar, ribbed cuffs and waistband that sit close against a cold wind. Angled flap pockets, for a ticket stub or a folded letter. On the left chest, a white YALE wordmark, small and unhurried. Wear it to The Game. Wear it to the airport afterward. It knows the way.

brooks-brothers-double-knit-full-zip-hoo.tagline: A navy Brooks Brothers double-knit full-zip hoodie. A white YALE on the left chest, and the good sense to say no more.
brooks-brothers-double-knit-full-zip-hoo.story: There is a type of person who looks put together at seven in the morning. I am not that person, but I have studied them. Their secret, I suspect, is a garment like this. A navy Brooks Brothers double-knit hoodie with a full front zip, a drawstring hood, kangaroo pockets, and ribbed cuffs and hem. On the left chest, a white YALE wordmark, no larger than it needs to be. It goes to the coffee shop. It goes to the office. It goes, discreetly, to the reunion.

champion-full-zip-hood.tagline: Charcoal gray Champion full-zip, YALE across the chest in white and navy. Zip it up. Zip it down. Either way, home.
champion-full-zip-hood.story: Charcoal is the color of New Haven in February, of wet slate and early dusk and the stone of buildings that have watched many generations hurry past. This Champion full-zip hoodie wears that color well. Large YALE lettering in white and navy runs across the chest. A drawstring hood for sleet, front kangaroo pockets for cold hands, ribbed cuffs and hem. Zip it halfway for the library. All the way for the walk back. Leave it open when the sun finally returns.

champion-mens-triumph-raglan-crew.tagline: Dark heather gray Champion raglan crew. YALE in bold white, EST. 1701 beneath it. Old news, worn proudly.
champion-mens-triumph-raglan-crew.story: 1701. Say it slowly. A number like that gives a person perspective on a bad week. This men's Champion raglan crewneck carries it plainly: bold white YALE lettering across the chest, EST. 1701 set beneath. The color is dark heather gray, the sort of shade that looks better the longer you consider it. The collar, cuffs, and waistband are ribbed. The raglan sleeves run in a clean line from collar to cuff. Some institutions are old. This sweatshirt simply admits it.

champion-reverse-weave-crewneck.tagline: Light gray Champion Reverse Weave, YALE arched across the chest in navy. A classic that never asked to be one.
champion-reverse-weave-crewneck.story: Every campus has its uniform, though nobody admits to wearing one. At Yale it might look like this: a light gray Champion Reverse Weave crewneck, large navy YALE lettering arched across the chest like a doorway you have already walked through. Ribbed collar, ribbed cuffs, ribbed waistband. Nothing extraneous. I saw one draped over a chair in a reading room on a snowy afternoon, its owner nowhere in sight, and understood immediately that they would be back. You do not leave a sweatshirt like this for long.

champion-reverse-weave-hoodie-1.tagline: Navy hoodie, an arched white YALE, and a small Champion C on the sleeve. A familiar companion for unfamiliar weather.
champion-reverse-weave-hoodie-1.story: Hoods are underrated. They are a private room you can carry around. This navy pullover hoodie has a good one, with a drawstring, and beneath it a white YALE arched across the chest. A front kangaroo pocket. Ribbed cuffs and waistband. A small Champion C logo on the sleeve, the sort of detail you notice on the third day. Wear it on the train from Grand Central with the hood up and a book open. When the conductor calls New Haven, you will already feel arrived.

crew-left-chest-hoodie.tagline: YALE CREW in white on the left chest of a navy hoodie. For those who know what five a.m. on the water feels like.
crew-left-chest-hoodie.story: Before dawn, the river is all mist and the sound of oars. A coxswain's voice carries further than seems possible. Nobody talks about the cold, because talking about it would mean admitting it exists. This navy blue pullover hoodie, with white YALE CREW lettering on the left chest, is for the walk back afterward, damp and triumphant. Drawstring hood. Kangaroo pocket. Ribbed cuffs and hem. Also suitable for those who merely admire rowing from the riverbank, holding coffee. No judgment. Some of us cheer.

davenport-college-crewneck.tagline: Heather gray crewneck, a small Davenport College crest and DAVENPORT on the left chest. Understated, like a well-kept secret.
davenport-college-crewneck.story: A residential college is not a dormitory. It is an argument you lose happily for four years and then defend for the rest of your life. This crewneck is for Davenport. Heather gray, ribbed at the collar, cuffs, and waistband, with a small Davenport College crest and DAVENPORT text on the left chest. Nothing more. It is the sweatshirt you wear on a Sunday afternoon with nothing scheduled, the one you pack first when you leave, and the one you find yourself wearing at your reunion.

district-tri-blend-t-shirt-vintage-shiel.tagline: A vintage Yale shield in navy and white, centered on heather gray tri-blend. History, at a comfortable distance.
district-tri-blend-t-shirt-vintage-shiel.story: Shields were originally meant for battle. Now they adorn letterhead and gateways and, in this case, the front of a heather gray tri-blend T-shirt. The vintage Yale shield crest sits centered on the chest in navy and white, as though it had been copied by hand from a worn book in a reading room. Wear it on a summer afternoon on the Green. Wear it under a jacket in autumn. It is a quiet way to say where you come from, without raising your voice.

district-vit-crewneck-vintage-bulldog.tagline: Dark heather charcoal, a large white YALE, and a vintage bulldog keeping watch. Loyal, steady, slightly stubborn. Like its wearer.
district-vit-crewneck-vintage-bulldog.story: Bulldogs do not sprint. They persist. I have always found that admirable. This dark heather charcoal crewneck carries a large white YALE wordmark and a vintage bulldog illustration on the front, an old friend drawn in the manner of another era. Ribbed collar, cuffs, and waistband. Wear it to the hockey rink, where the air is cold enough to see your cheering. Wear it to the library, where cheering is discouraged. The bulldog will understand either way. He has seen everything.

district-vit-crewneck-vintage-standing-b.tagline: A standing vintage bulldog in white with navy accents, YALE stacked tall. Heather charcoal gray. Thoroughly unbothered.
district-vit-crewneck-vintage-standing-b.story: He stands. That is the whole point. Not crouched, not snarling, simply standing, the way one does when one has every right to be there. This heather charcoal gray crewneck features a vintage-style white Yale bulldog graphic with navy accents, and YALE lettering stacked vertically like a column holding up a very old roof. Long sleeves, for the walk between buildings when the wind finds the gaps. A sweatshirt with posture. Few of us can say the same before coffee.

district-vit-hoodie-vintage-bulldog.tagline: The vintage bulldog, now with a hood. Dark heather gray, white YALE, and a kangaroo pocket for cold New Haven hands.
district-vit-hoodie-vintage-bulldog.story: Winter on Cross Campus has a particular silence. Snow on the lawns. Footprints in diagonal lines, everyone taking the shortest route to warmth. This dark heather gray pullover hoodie was made for that walk. A white YALE wordmark and vintage bulldog graphic on the front. A drawstring hood for the gusts. A kangaroo pocket for hands that forgot their gloves again. Ribbed cuffs and ribbed hem. The bulldog, I am told, does not feel the cold. You might.

district-vit-hoodie-vintage-sailor-bulld.tagline: A vintage bulldog in a sailor hat, beneath an arched white YALE. Charcoal gray. Ready for shore leave on Long Wharf.
district-vit-hoodie-vintage-sailor-bulld.story: Every harbor town has its characters. The old salt on the bench. The dog who rides the ferry daily and pays no fare. New Haven, being a harbor town, deserves one too, and here he is: a vintage-style bulldog wearing a sailor hat, beneath an arched white YALE wordmark, on a charcoal gray pullover hoodie. A front kangaroo pocket. Ribbed cuffs and hem. Wear it for a breezy walk along Long Wharf, watching the water. Salute optional. The bulldog will salute for you.

diving-left-chest-crewneck.tagline: YALE DIVING in white on the left chest of a navy crewneck. For those who step off the board without looking back.
diving-left-chest-crewneck.story: Divers know a particular moment: toes at the edge, the pool very still below, everything else gone quiet. Then the leap, and the clean entry, and the surface closing overhead. It takes nerve. This navy blue crewneck honors that nerve, with a white YALE DIVING wordmark on the left chest and ribbed collar, cuffs, and hem. Wear it on deck between rounds. Wear it to class with damp hair and nothing to prove. You already proved it, somewhere high above the water.

divinity-school-fleece-sweater.tagline: Navy heathered fleece, a stand collar, a full zip, and the Yale Divinity School crest. Contemplation, warmly dressed.
divinity-school-fleece-sweater.story: Up on the hill, the Divinity School keeps its own pace. Long thoughts. Longer readings. Conversations about the largest questions, conducted over the smallest cups of coffee. This navy blue heathered fleece jacket suits that pace. A stand collar, a full front zipper, long sleeves for the drafty corners of old buildings, and Yale Divinity School text and crest on the left chest. Wear it to morning reading. Wear it on a walk to clear your head. Some questions are best considered when one is warm.

dry-zone-long-sleeve.tagline: Navy long-sleeve performance shirt, YALE in bold white with BULLDOGS beneath. For the morning run up Science Hill.
dry-zone-long-sleeve.story: Six a.m. The streets are empty except for a delivery truck and you. The breath comes in clouds. The legs complain, then quiet down. This navy long-sleeve athletic performance shirt is for that hour. Bold white YALE lettering on the front, BULLDOGS beneath it, so that anyone you pass knows exactly whose side you are on. Wear it for the run, the gym, the intramural field. Wear it also for sitting very still afterward, feeling virtuous, with a large breakfast.

fencing-left-chest-hoodie.tagline: En garde, quietly. White YALE FENCING lettering on a navy hoodie, for those who settle disputes with elegance.
fencing-left-chest-hoodie.story: Fencing is conversation with consequences. Advance, retreat, a feint, a reply. I once watched a bout through a gymnasium door and could not look away; it was chess played at the speed of breath. This navy blue pullover hoodie carries white YALE FENCING lettering on the left chest. A drawstring hood. Long sleeves with ribbed cuffs. A ribbed hem and a front kangaroo pocket. Wear it to practice. Wear it to the dining hall afterward, where the arguments are verbal but no less precise.

football-left-chest-t-shirt.tagline: A small white YALE FOOTBALL wordmark on navy. For the faithful who arrive at the Bowl early and leave reluctantly.
football-left-chest-t-shirt.story: There is a moment, just before kickoff at the Yale Bowl, when the whole stadium seems to inhale. Pennants still. Band poised. Then the whistle, and the exhale is a roar. This navy short-sleeve T-shirt belongs to that moment. Crew neck, short sleeves, and a small white YALE FOOTBALL wordmark printed on the left chest. It doesn't need a large graphic. The day will be loud enough. Wear it under a jacket for a November game, or by itself on a September Saturday.

grace-hopper-college-crewneck.tagline: A small Grace Hopper College crest on navy. Clean lines, clear logic, and a sweatshirt that simply runs without errors.
grace-hopper-college-crewneck.story: Elegance, the engineers say, is a solution with nothing unnecessary in it. This navy long-sleeve crewneck would pass that test. A small Grace Hopper College crest and text on the left chest. Nothing else to debug. It is the sweatshirt for late nights in a common room when the code finally compiles, for early mornings when the coffee machine does not, and for the walk across campus in between. Pull it on. Get to work. Let the results speak for themselves.

grace-hopper-logo-t-shirt.tagline: The Grace Hopper College crest, centered on heather gray, with GRACE HOPPER COLLEGE in black beneath. Pride, printed plainly.
grace-hopper-logo-t-shirt.story: Some T-shirts announce a team. This one announces a household. The Grace Hopper College crest sits centered on the chest of a heather gray crew-neck T-shirt, with GRACE HOPPER COLLEGE in black lettering beneath. It is what you wear to the college barbecue, to the intramural game, to the move-in afternoon when you carry a lamp up four flights for a first-year who will one day do the same for someone else. Traditions are made that way. One lamp at a time.

hype-and-vice-yale-university-offside-cr.tagline: Bold white block-letter YALE on navy, a small outlined logo on the sleeve. Direct, confident, and dressed for a crowd.
hype-and-vice-yale-university-offside-cr.story: Block letters do not hedge. They stand shoulder to shoulder and hold the line. This navy Hype and Vice crewneck carries a bold white block-letter YALE wordmark across the chest, the kind of lettering you can read from the upper rows of the stands. Ribbed collar, cuffs, and hem. A small outlined logo on the sleeve, for the observant. Wear it to the tailgate, to the coffee line, to the Saturday you meant to study and somehow didn't. No regrets. The letters never have any.

hype-and-vice-yale-university-premium-cr.tagline: White crewneck, navy ribbing, collegiate lettering and a centered Yale crest. Crisp as the first snowfall on Old Campus.
hype-and-vice-yale-university-premium-cr.story: White is a brave choice. It assumes you will not spill the cider. This Hype and Vice premium crewneck makes that assumption gracefully: a white body, navy ribbed collar, cuffs, and waistband like the trim on a well-kept boathouse, collegiate lettering, and a centered Yale crest. I would wear it to a brunch where someone has thought carefully about the flowers. I would also wear it on a crisp autumn walk, keeping a respectful distance from the mustard.

ice-hockey-left-chest-hoodie.tagline: White YALE HOCKEY on the left chest of a navy hoodie. For rinkside nights when your breath shows and your voice gives out.
ice-hockey-left-chest-hoodie.story: Ice rinks are cathedrals of cold. The echo of skates. The thud of the puck against the boards. The sudden, unanimous roar. I learned to love hockey in a rink where the coffee froze if you were too slow with it. This navy blue pullover hooded sweatshirt is for nights like those: drawstrings, a kangaroo pocket for chilled hands, long sleeves, and a white YALE HOCKEY graphic on the left chest. Bring a scarf. Bring your voice. You will leave with only one of them.

jonathan-edwards-college-crewneck.tagline: A small Jonathan Edwards College crest on heather gray. For those who have known the same courtyard through every season.
jonathan-edwards-college-crewneck.story: Some courtyards feel like a held breath. Stone walls. A lawn worn into paths by generations of shortcuts. A window lit late into the night by someone finishing a thesis. This heather gray crewneck belongs to Jonathan Edwards College, its small crest and college name sitting on the left chest. Long sleeves for the cold months. Wear it to a study break. Wear it home over winter recess and watch your family pretend not to be impressed. They are impressed. They will mention it to the neighbors.

lacrosse-left-chest-crewneck.tagline: Navy crewneck, white YALE LACROSSE on the left chest. Spring sidelines, cold bleachers, and the sound of sticks meeting.
lacrosse-left-chest-crewneck.story: Lacrosse season arrives before the weather does. Players in short sleeves; spectators wrapped in everything they own. A long whistle. A quick pass. A goal, and the bleachers rattle. This navy long-sleeve crewneck is for the spectators, and the players afterward. Ribbed collar, cuffs, and waistband. A white YALE LACROSSE wordmark on the left chest. Simple enough to wear to class the next morning, with the faint and pleasant sense that something important happened the day before and you were there.

morse-1-4-zip.tagline: Light heather gray quarter-zip with a small Morse College crest. Old loyalties, clean lines, and a collar that stands up for itself.
morse-1-4-zip.story: Loyalty, I've noticed, is often expressed quietly: a nod across the dining hall, a saved seat, a small crest worn where only the attentive will spot it. Here it is a small Morse College crest on the left chest of a light heather gray quarter-zip pullover. Stand collar. Ribbed cuffs and hem. Wear it on a gray afternoon when the stone looks its most dramatic. Wear it to the airport when you leave New Haven, and to the one where you return. It does not need a reason.

morse-logo-t-shirt.tagline: The Morse College shield, a red axe among black details, MORSE COLLEGE beneath. Heather gray, and slightly fearless.
morse-logo-t-shirt.story: An axe on a crest tells you something. Not menace, exactly. Resolve. This heather gray crew-neck T-shirt carries the Morse College shield crest centered on the chest, a red axe and black details above the words MORSE COLLEGE. Short sleeves for the warm weeks of September and the surprising ones in May. I once saw this shirt on a student carrying an enormous stack of library books with total composure. That is the energy. Steady hands. Clear purpose. Red axe.

pierson-college-crewneck.tagline: Navy crewneck with a small black-and-yellow Pierson College shield on the left chest. Proud, and unmistakably Pierson.
pierson-college-crewneck.story: Colleges at Yale keep their colors the way old families keep their silver. Here black and yellow appear in a small Pierson College shield crest on the left chest of a navy long-sleeve crewneck. Ribbed collar, cuffs, and waistband. Nothing extravagant. You wear it to a study break, to a late breakfast, to the day you finally understand the reading. Someone across the room will recognize the crest and smile. That is how alliances form. Small shields. Shared tables.

pierson-logo-t-shirt.tagline: The Pierson College crest centered on heather gray, PIERSON COLLEGE printed beneath. A short-sleeve declaration of home.
pierson-logo-t-shirt.story: The first week of the year is a blur of names and faces. Then, slowly, the faces become friends, the friends become a college, and the college becomes the thing you mean when you say home. This heather gray crew-neck T-shirt marks that arrival. The Pierson College crest is centered on the chest, with PIERSON COLLEGE printed beneath. Short sleeves. Wear it to the courtyard on the first warm day of spring, when everyone emerges blinking from the libraries at once.

poly-twill-crewneck-arched-yale.tagline: Cream crewneck, YALE arched large in navy. The color of old letters and the confidence of a long tradition.
poly-twill-crewneck-arched-yale.story: Cream is navy's most loyal companion. They have stood together on pennants and blazers and old varsity sweaters in faded photographs, and they stand together here. A classic cream crewneck sweatshirt, ribbed at the collar, cuffs, and waistband, with a large navy YALE wordmark arched across the front. It looks the way autumn smells: leaves, wood smoke, a radiator coming on for the first time. Wear it to a football game. Wear it beside a fireplace. Both will approve.

sailing-left-chest-hoodie.tagline: Navy hoodie, a white YALE SAILING graphic at the left chest. Salt air, a steady breeze, and the Sound on the horizon.
sailing-left-chest-hoodie.story: Long Island Sound in early autumn. A steady breeze. Sails trimmed. Somebody shouts a command I do not entirely understand, and the boat leans, and the world tilts gloriously sideways. This navy blue pullover hoodie, with a white YALE SAILING graphic at the left chest, is for the ride back to shore. A drawstring hood for spray. A front kangaroo pocket. Ribbed cuffs and hem. Equally at home on the dock, at the library, or on any shoreline facing into the wind.

saybrook-college-crewneck.tagline: Navy crewneck, a small multicolor Saybrook College crest and SAYBROOK on the left chest. Loyalty, worn into the everyday.
saybrook-college-crewneck.story: Ask a Saybrook resident about Saybrook and pull up a chair. The answer will take a while. It will involve courtyards and traditions and at least one story that cannot be repeated in print. This navy long-sleeve crewneck says all of that in fewer words. Ribbed collar, cuffs, and waistband. A small multicolor Saybrook College crest and SAYBROOK text on the left chest. Wear it to dinner. Wear it to a reunion decades from now. The stories will have improved by then.

saybrook-logo-t-shirt.tagline: Saybrook's heraldic shield in blue, yellow, and black, centered on heather gray, SAYBROOK COLLEGE beneath. Heraldry for every day.
saybrook-logo-t-shirt.story: Heraldry was the original social network: who you were, whom you belonged to, all on a shield. Saybrook's appears here in blue, yellow, and black, centered on the chest of a heather gray short-sleeve T-shirt, with SAYBROOK COLLEGE in text beneath. Wear it on a warm afternoon in the courtyard, a frisbee overhead and a paperback unopened in your lap. Wear it on the day you move in, and again on the day you leave. In between, wear it often.

saybrook-sweater-fleece-jacket.tagline: Heather gray sweater fleece, charcoal trim, an embroidered Saybrook College crest. The jacket you reach for without thinking.
saybrook-sweater-fleece-jacket.story: Every wardrobe has one honest garment. The one you reach for before you have decided anything. This could be it. A heather gray full-zip sweater fleece jacket with a stand collar, charcoal gray zipper and pocket trim, and an embroidered Saybrook College crest on the left chest. Over a shirt. Under a coat. It looks just as right at a seminar table as it does on a cold bench at a soccer game. Saybrook, carried quietly, wherever the day goes.

school-of-architecture-crewneck.tagline: Navy quarter-zip with Yale School of Architecture branding at the left chest. Clean lines. Considered proportions. Late studio nights.
school-of-architecture-crewneck.story: Architects see the world in sections and elevations. They notice how light falls across a stair, how a window frames the sky. They also, famously, keep late hours in the studio. This navy long-sleeve quarter-zip pullover was made for both habits. A stand collar. Ribbed cuffs and hem. Yale School of Architecture branding on the left chest. Its lines are clean, its zipper ready for when the studio gets warm around two in the morning. Model glue not included.

school-of-architecture-fleece-sweater.tagline: Navy full-zip fleece with Yale School of Architecture text and shield crest. For drafty studios and long critiques.
school-of-architecture-fleece-sweater.story: A final review is a kind of theater. Drawings pinned to the wall. Critics leaning forward. The student, very calm, very tired, explaining a building that does not yet exist. You want something reliable for that day. This navy blue full-zip fleece jacket has a stand collar, long sleeves, front pockets for pencils and nerves, and Yale School of Architecture text and shield crest on the left chest. Wear it into the review. Wear it out, triumphant, into the evening air.

school-of-art-1-4-zip.tagline: Navy quarter-zip, Yale School of Art text and a multicolor shield crest. For the artist who prefers color on the canvas.
school-of-art-1-4-zip.story: Artists are permitted to dress however they like, which is perhaps why so many of them settle on navy. It flatters light. It lets the work do the talking. This navy long-sleeve quarter-zip pullover has a stand collar, ribbed cuffs and hem, and Yale School of Art text with a multicolor shield crest on the left chest. Wear it to a gallery opening on Chapel Street. Wear it to the studio. Wear it home with a streak of cadmium on the sleeve, which only improves it.

school-of-art-fleece-sweater.tagline: Navy full-zip fleece with Yale School of Art text and a colorful crest. Zippered pockets, for brushes and big ideas.
school-of-art-fleece-sweater.story: The studio is always colder than you expect. Something to do with high ceilings and open windows and the smell of turpentine needing somewhere to go. This navy blue full-zip fleece jacket is the sensible answer. A stand collar. Long sleeves. Zippered front pockets for keys, a pencil, a ticket from a museum you visited on a whim. Yale School of Art text and a colorful crest on the left chest. Practical, yes. But with a flicker of color right where it counts.

school-of-engineering-1-4-zip.tagline: Navy quarter-zip with the Yale School of Engineering and Applied Science crest and lettering. Precision, worn at the left chest.
school-of-engineering-1-4-zip.story: Engineers trust things that work. Bridges that hold. Circuits that close. Proofs that end with a small, satisfied square. This navy long-sleeve quarter-zip pullover is made in that spirit: a stand collar, ribbed cuffs and hem, and the Yale School of Engineering and Applied Science crest and lettering on the left chest. Zip it up for a cold lab. Zip it down when the experiment finally succeeds. It will not tell you the answer. It will keep you company while you find it.

school-of-management-crest-t-shirt.tagline: Navy tee with white Yale School of Management lettering and a shield crest in white and light blue. Strategy, short sleeves.
school-of-management-crest-t-shirt.story: Case study, Tuesday morning. The room is divided, the professor is enjoying it, and someone in the back is about to make the comment that changes everything. This is a T-shirt for the aftermath. Navy, short-sleeved, with white Yale School of Management lettering and a centered shield crest in white and light blue. Wear it to the weekend study group. Wear it to the gym, where at least the problems have clear solutions. Leadership, I am told, begins with knowing when to dress comfortably.

school-of-medicine-1-4-zip.tagline: Navy quarter-zip, Yale School of Medicine text and a multicolor shield crest. Steady hands deserve a steady layer.
school-of-medicine-1-4-zip.story: Medicine keeps unreasonable hours. Early rounds. Late study. Coffee drunk at temperatures that would alarm a chemist. Through all of it, a person needs one dependable layer. This navy long-sleeve quarter-zip pullover offers exactly that. A stand collar against hospital air conditioning. Ribbed cuffs and hem. Yale School of Medicine text and a multicolor shield crest on the left chest. Wear it on the walk to the hospital before sunrise. Wear it home after, when the city is quiet and the work was worth it.

school-of-music-fleece-sweater.tagline: Navy full-zip fleece, Yale School of Music text and a colorful shield crest. For practice rooms, rehearsals, and encores.
school-of-music-fleece-sweater.story: Practice rooms are small and honest. A piano, a stand, a window, and the same eight bars played until they finally sing. Musicians spend long hours in rooms like these, and they want something warm that does not fuss. This navy blue full-zip fleece jacket has a stand collar, long sleeves, side pockets, and Yale School of Music text with a colorful shield crest on the left chest. Wear it to rehearsal. Wear it to the concert hall lobby afterward. Take a bow. Then zip up.

school-of-nursing-crest-t-shirt.tagline: White YALE SCHOOL OF NURSING lettering across navy, the school's shield crest centered below. Care, worn with pride.
school-of-nursing-crest-t-shirt.story: There are professions measured in titles and professions measured in moments: a steady voice, a calm hand, a long shift finished with grace. Nursing is the second kind. This navy blue crew-neck T-shirt carries white YALE SCHOOL OF NURSING lettering across the chest, with the Yale School of Nursing shield crest centered below. Short sleeves. Easy. Wear it on your day off, when the pager is silent and the coffee is hot for once. You earned that coffee. You earned this shirt.

school-of-public-health-1-4-zip.tagline: Navy quarter-zip with white Yale School of Public Health text and a multicolor shield crest. For those who think in populations.
school-of-public-health-1-4-zip.story: Public health is a discipline of large numbers and small kindnesses. Data on a screen. A neighborhood behind each data point. This navy long-sleeve quarter-zip pullover is for people who keep both in mind. A stand collar. Ribbed cuffs and hem. White Yale School of Public Health text and a multicolor shield crest on the left chest. Wear it to a morning seminar, to an afternoon in the field, to the evening when you finally finish the analysis and step outside into the cool air.

soccer-left-chest-crewneck.tagline: Navy crewneck, white YALE SOCCER on the left chest. For autumn evenings under the lights and a crowd that sings.
soccer-left-chest-crewneck.story: Soccer at dusk is its own kind of poetry. Floodlights coming on. The grass turning a deeper green. A long ball, a sprint, a sudden roar from the stands. I have watched the game in many countries and the feeling is always the same. This navy blue long-sleeve crewneck brings it home, with a white YALE SOCCER wordmark printed on the left chest. Simple and sure of itself. Wear it to the match, to class the next morning, to any field where the ball is rolling.

squash-left-chest-hoodie.tagline: White YALE SQUASH on a navy hoodie. For the player who leaves the court winded, victorious, and in need of a hood.
squash-left-chest-hoodie.story: Squash is a game played in a white box at the speed of thought. The ball cracks off the front wall, the shoes squeak, and two people chase the same small target with great courtesy and no mercy. Afterward, you want a hood. This navy blue pullover hoodie has one, with a drawstring, plus a kangaroo pocket, ribbed cuffs and hem, and a white YALE SQUASH print on the left chest. Pull it on. Catch your breath. Rematch on Thursday.

squash-left-chest-tennis.tagline: Navy crewneck, a small white YALE SQUASH graphic on the left chest. Courtside composure, from first serve to final rally.
squash-left-chest-tennis.story: There is a kind of athlete who is calm off the court and ferocious on it. You would never guess, watching them over breakfast. This navy blue crewneck suits that temperament. A small white YALE SQUASH graphic on the left chest, ribbed collar, cuffs, and waistband, and nothing else to give the game away. Wear it on the walk to the courts on a frosty morning. Wear it to lunch after, racquet bag on your shoulder, saying very little about the score.

super-heavyweight-crewneck-arched-yale-c.tagline: Heavyweight heather gray, YALE arched in navy and white, a bulldog mascot over a Y crest. Made for January.
super-heavyweight-crewneck-arched-yale-c.story: January in New Haven tests one's character. The wind off the harbor finds every gap in every coat. The sun sets before you have finished lunch, or so it feels. You need reinforcements. This heavyweight heather gray crewneck sweatshirt reports for duty, with arched YALE lettering in navy and white and a centered Yale bulldog mascot over a Y crest. It is substantial. It is serious. It is the sweatshirt you pull on, and suddenly the winter seems a little more negotiable.

t-felt-y-heavyweight.tagline: Cream heavyweight T-shirt with a large navy block Y. One letter, no explanation. The rest is understood.
t-felt-y-heavyweight.story: One letter. That is all. A large navy Yale block Y on the front of a cream heavyweight short-sleeve T-shirt, with a crew neckline. It recalls the old letter sweaters in sepia photographs, the kind that seem to hang in every boathouse and reunion tent. Wear it on a summer evening on the Green, or under a jacket when the leaves turn. Some symbols require explanation. This one has never needed any. Wear it, and let people do the remembering.

the-forest-school-hoodie.tagline: Navy hoodie, bold white YALE above THE FOREST SCHOOL. For people who would rather be standing among the trees.
the-forest-school-hoodie.story: Some people study the forest from a desk. Others prefer to go stand in it, boots damp, notebook out, listening to the canopy. This navy pullover hoodie is for both kinds. A drawstring hood for drizzle. A front kangaroo pocket for a field guide or a granola bar. Bold white YALE lettering above THE FOREST SCHOOL text on the front. Wear it on a fieldwork morning in the Connecticut woods. Wear it back in the city, smelling faintly of pine and quiet satisfaction.

timothy-dwight-college-crewneck.tagline: A crewneck for Timothy Dwight College. For residents, alumni, and anyone who has ever proudly called TD home.
timothy-dwight-college-crewneck.story: Every college has its own weather. Its own jokes, its own rituals, its own way of welcoming you back after a long break. Timothy Dwight is no exception, and its people tend to say so with some feeling. This crewneck is for them. It is made for chilly mornings and late-night study breaks, for the walk across campus when the leaves are falling, and for the reunions where everyone pretends not to have changed at all. A simple garment. A deep allegiance.

track-field-left-chest-t-shirt.tagline: Navy tee with a small white YALE Track & Field design at the left chest. Laps, sprints, and the long cooldown home.
track-field-left-chest-t-shirt.story: The track at dawn has a meditative quality. White lines curving away into the mist. The soft rhythm of feet. A coach with a stopwatch, saying nothing, which says plenty. This navy short-sleeve T-shirt carries a small white YALE Track & Field design on the left chest. Wear it for warm-ups. Wear it for the walk to class with legs still humming. Wear it, perhaps, as encouragement on mornings when you would rather not run at all. We have all had those.

tri-blend-sports-baseball-t-shirt.tagline: Heather gray tri-blend with navy YALE BASEBALL lettering and a Yale Y. Summer afternoons, sunflower seeds, extra innings.
tri-blend-sports-baseball-t-shirt.story: Baseball rewards patience. Long innings, sudden thunder, then quiet again while the pitcher considers his options. A good T-shirt for baseball should share that temperament. This heather gray short-sleeve tri-blend sports T-shirt does. Navy YALE BASEBALL lettering and a Yale Y mark on the front. Easy to wear in the bleachers on a warm day, at a cookout, or while explaining the infield fly rule to someone who did not ask. They never ask. Explain anyway.

tri-blend-sports-basketball-t-shirt.tagline: Heather gray tri-blend with large navy YALE, BASKETBALL text, and a Yale Y logo. For the squeak of sneakers in a packed gym.
tri-blend-sports-basketball-t-shirt.story: Winter evenings belong to basketball. Outside, sleet. Inside, a packed gymnasium, the squeak of sneakers, the hush before a free throw, the eruption after. This heather gray short-sleeve tri-blend sports T-shirt is a small piece of that warmth. Large navy YALE lettering, BASKETBALL text, and a Yale Y logo on the front. Wear it under a sweater to the game. Wear it on its own for a pickup match on a summer court. The ball, as they say, does not care about the weather.

tri-blend-sports-football-t-shirt.tagline: Heather gray tee, bold navy YALE FOOTBALL with a block Y beneath. For autumn Saturdays and the Bowl in full voice.
tri-blend-sports-football-t-shirt.story: Autumn Saturdays have a choreography all their own. Leaves underfoot. A tailgate unfolding in the parking lot. A long walk toward the Yale Bowl with thousands of others, all of us pretending to be calm. This heather gray short-sleeve athletic-style T-shirt fits right in. Bold navy YALE FOOTBALL lettering across the front, with a navy Yale block Y beneath. Wear it under a coat in November. Wear it on its own in September, when hope is high and the season is young.

tri-blend-sports-hockey-t-shirt.tagline: Heather gray tri-blend, large navy YALE and HOCKEY lettering, a Yale Y emblem below. Rink-ready, even in July.
tri-blend-sports-hockey-t-shirt.story: Hockey fans are a seasonal species, but their devotion is year-round. In July they can be spotted on beaches and porches, still talking about a goal from February. This heather gray tri-blend short-sleeve T-shirt is for them. Large navy YALE and HOCKEY lettering on the front, with a Yale Y emblem below. Wear it to summer barbecues. Wear it under a heavier layer when the season returns and the rink calls you back. The ice will be waiting. So will your seat.

tri-blend-sports-soccer-t-shirt.tagline: Heather gray crew-neck tee, navy YALE SOCCER lettering and a large block Y. The world's game, with a New Haven accent.
tri-blend-sports-soccer-t-shirt.story: Soccer is spoken everywhere. I have heard it argued in train stations in Lisbon and cafes in Buenos Aires, always with the same passion and roughly the same hand gestures. In New Haven it is spoken too, and this heather gray short-sleeve crew-neck T-shirt is fluent. Centered navy blue YALE SOCCER lettering, with a large block Y graphic. Wear it to a match. Wear it to a pickup game on the Green. Wear it while you argue about the referee. Everyone does.

tri-blend-sports-tennis-t-shirt.tagline: Heather gray crew-neck tee, navy YALE and TENNIS lettering over a large block Y. Love, all. Advantage, you.
tri-blend-sports-tennis-t-shirt.story: Tennis is a polite game with an impolite heart. Players shake hands, then spend two hours trying to outthink each other. This heather gray short-sleeve crew-neck T-shirt has the manners for it. Navy blue YALE and TENNIS lettering with a large block Y below. Wear it to the courts on a spring morning, when the lines are fresh and the competition is friendly, at least officially. Wear it afterward with a cold lemonade, replaying every point. Especially the ones you won.

tri-blend-sports-track-and-field-t-shirt.tagline: Heather gray tee with a navy Yale wordmark, TRACK & FIELD text, and a block Y. Every lap counts. So does every stretch.
tri-blend-sports-track-and-field-t-shirt.story: Track and field is a festival disguised as a sport. Sprinters, jumpers, throwers, distance runners, each with their own rituals, all sharing one oval. I once spent an entire afternoon watching a high jumper try the same height again and again until, at last, the bar stayed put. This heather gray short-sleeve T-shirt honors that persistence, with a navy Yale wordmark, TRACK & FIELD text, and a block Y emblem centered on the chest. Wear it to the meet. Wear it for the long cooldown after.

trumbull-1-4-zip.tagline: Heather gray quarter-zip, the Trumbull College crest with TRUMBULL on the left chest. Courtyard loyalty, zipped to the chin.
trumbull-1-4-zip.story: A good quarter-zip is a matter of judgment. Collar up for wind. Zipper down for conversation. Sleeves pushed back when the discussion becomes animated. This long-sleeve heather gray quarter-zip pullover handles all three. A stand collar. Ribbed cuffs and hem. A Trumbull College crest with TRUMBULL text on the left chest. Wear it on the morning walk past the stone gateways, to the library, to the dining hall where everybody knows your usual order. Trumbull, worn close.

ua-gameday-double-knit-hood.tagline: Navy double-knit hooded pullover, a white-lined hood and a white Yale Y. Game day, from tailgate to final whistle.
ua-gameday-double-knit-hood.story: Game day starts early. A coffee in the dark, a scarf from the closet, the drive toward the Bowl with the radio already talking. This Under Armour navy double-knit hooded pullover is dressed for the occasion. A hood lined in white, a white Yale Y mark on the chest, a kangaroo pocket for tickets and cold fingers, and an Under Armour logo on the sleeve. Pull the hood up in the third quarter when the wind turns. Pull it down for the victory song.

ua-mens-tech-l-s-2-0.tagline: Navy long-sleeve performance shirt with outlined white YALE, a large Y, BULLDOGS, and a stripe. For the workout, and beyond it.
ua-mens-tech-l-s-2-0.story: The gym at dawn is a democracy. Varsity athletes, graduate students, a professor on the rowing machine, all of us equally unglamorous. This navy men's long-sleeve athletic performance shirt helps a little. White outlined YALE lettering, a large Y, BULLDOGS text, a decorative stripe detail, and Under Armour branding on the chest. Wear it for the run along the harbor. Wear it to lift. Wear it for the walk home afterward, when the city is just waking up and you have already won the day.

volleyball-left-chest-hoodie.tagline: Navy hoodie with white YALE VOLLEYBALL lettering on the left chest. Set, spike, and a warm hood for the walk home.
volleyball-left-chest-hoodie.story: Volleyball is a sport of brief flight. A player rises, hangs in the air for a heartbeat, and brings the ball down like a verdict. The gym erupts. Then everyone resets, calm again, for the next point. This navy pullover hoodie has white YALE VOLLEYBALL lettering on the left chest, a drawstring hood, a kangaroo front pocket, and ribbed cuffs and hem. Wear it between matches. Wear it to the dining hall afterward, your voice hoarse, your spirits high.

yale-aunt-hoodie.tagline: Navy hoodie with a white Yale University Aunt graphic. For the aunt who sent care packages and never missed a visit.
yale-aunt-hoodie.story: Every family has one. The aunt who sends the care package with exactly the right snacks. The aunt who drives up for family weekend even though she is not, technically, a parent. The aunt who brags, shamelessly and correctly. This navy pullover hoodie is for her: a white Yale University Aunt graphic across the chest, a drawstring hood, and a front kangaroo pocket for her phone, which is full of photos. She has earned the title. Let her wear it.

yale-bowl-t-shirt.tagline: Ivory tee with navy ribbed trim and a vintage Yale Bowl illustration. Leather. Wind. The Bowl at dusk.
yale-bowl-t-shirt.story: I first saw the Yale Bowl in late afternoon, the sun dropping behind the rim, the field glowing like a stage just before the curtain. Some places are bigger inside than out. This ivory T-shirt remembers it in a vintage stadium illustration with collegiate typography across the chest. A navy contrast ribbed crew neck and navy ribbed sleeve cuffs frame it all neatly. Wear it to the Bowl on game day. Wear it on any day you'd like to hear the roar of a crowd, quietly.

yale-brother-crewneck.tagline: Heather gray crewneck, a navy Yale wordmark between horizontal lines, BROTHER beneath. Sibling pride, finally made official.
yale-brother-crewneck.story: Brothers have a complicated relationship with praise. They will not say it out loud. They will, however, wear it. This heather gray long-sleeve crewneck sweatshirt lets them do so: a large navy Yale wordmark set between horizontal lines, with the word BROTHER beneath. Wear it to move-in day while carrying the heaviest box. Wear it to Thanksgiving dinner and accept no questions. It says what he means, which is: I am proud of you, and I would like a tour.

yale-cousin-crewneck.tagline: Heather gray crewneck with a navy Yale wordmark, UNIVERSITY and COUSIN. For the relative who brags at every reunion.
yale-cousin-crewneck.story: Cousins occupy a special place in family life: close enough to brag about you, distant enough to exaggerate. This heather gray long-sleeve crewneck sweatshirt gives them the proper uniform. A large navy Yale wordmark, UNIVERSITY and COUSIN text, and navy horizontal accent lines across the chest. Wear it to the family reunion. Wear it to the holiday table. Wear it while telling the story, once again, of how you always knew they would end up somewhere like New Haven. You did not. But it is a good story.

yale-dad-crewneck.tagline: Heather gray crewneck with a navy Yale University Dad graphic. Proud, a little sentimental, and very happy to tell you why.
yale-dad-crewneck.story: He drove the minivan. He carried the mini-fridge up the stairs and pretended his back was fine. He waved from the curb a moment longer than necessary. This heather gray long-sleeve crewneck sweatshirt, with a navy blue Yale University Dad graphic across the chest, is for him. Wear it to the hardware store. Wear it to the grocery line. Wear it anywhere a stranger might ask, so that he can explain, at length, with photographs. He has been waiting for someone to ask.

yale-dad-hoodie.tagline: Navy hoodie with a bold white Yale University Dad graphic. For sideline cheering, airport pickups, and quiet pride.
yale-dad-hoodie.story: Somewhere there is a father standing at the edge of a field in October, hands in his pockets, trying to look casual. He is not casual. He is bursting. This navy blue pullover hoodie, with a bold white Yale University Dad graphic across the chest, lets the world in on it. A drawstring hood for drizzle. Long sleeves. A kangaroo front pocket for hands, keys, and the folded schedule of family weekend. Understatement was never his strong suit. Let the hoodie handle it.

yale-dad-t-shirt.tagline: Heather gray tee with a navy Yale University graphic and DAD across the chest. Fit for a backyard barbecue and a long story.
yale-dad-t-shirt.story: Summer. The grill is lit. A father stands over it with the authority of a ship's captain and the accuracy of a weather forecast. He is wearing this: a heather gray short-sleeve crew-neck T-shirt with a navy Yale University graphic and the word DAD across the chest. Neighbors notice. Questions are asked. Answers are given, generously, while the burgers wait. It is a T-shirt for the pride that does not need a special occasion, only a warm afternoon and an audience.

yale-diving-t-shirt.tagline: Heather gray tee with navy YALE and DIVING text and a Yale block Y. For those who greet the water headfirst.
yale-diving-t-shirt.story: The pool is quiet in the early morning. Just the hum of the filters and, now and then, the spring of a board, a pause, and a clean entry that barely disturbs the surface. Divers make it look effortless. It is not. This heather gray short-sleeve T-shirt honors the work behind the grace, with navy blue YALE and DIVING text and a Yale block Y logo on the chest. Wear it on deck. Wear it everywhere else, with the posture of someone who can do a backflip.

yale-grandma-hoodie.tagline: Navy hoodie with a white Yale wordmark, UNIVERSITY and GRANDMA beneath. For the woman who always believed, and said so.
yale-grandma-hoodie.story: She saw it coming before anyone. She clipped the newspaper articles, kept the report cards, and told the bridge club years in advance. This navy blue pullover hoodie is her victory lap. A white Yale wordmark across the chest, with smaller UNIVERSITY and GRANDMA text beneath. A drawstring hood, long sleeves, and a front kangaroo pocket for tissues, candies, and a photo she will show you whether or not you ask. Wear it to the graduation. Wear it to the supermarket. She deserves both.

yale-grandpa-crewneck.tagline: Heather gray crewneck, a large navy YALE, UNIVERSITY beneath, and GRANDPA below that. Wisdom, with bragging rights.
yale-grandpa-crewneck.story: Grandfathers speak in stories. The time the car broke down in the snow. The job he almost took. The grandchild who, against all expectation, is now studying in New Haven. That last story is his favorite. This heather gray long-sleeve crewneck sweatshirt lets him tell it without saying a word: a large navy YALE wordmark across the chest, UNIVERSITY beneath it, and GRANDPA text below. Wear it to the diner on Sunday. Someone will ask. He will be delighted.

yale-grandpa-hoodie.tagline: Navy hoodie with a large white Yale University Grandpa graphic. A drawstring hood, a kangaroo pocket, and a well-earned title.
yale-grandpa-hoodie.story: Some men wear tweed. Some wear cardigans. This one has decided, after careful consideration, to wear a hoodie, and nobody is going to talk him out of it. Navy blue, with a drawstring hood, a kangaroo pocket, ribbed cuffs and hem, and a large white Yale University Grandpa graphic across the chest. He will wear it to the hardware store, to the porch, to the airport to collect a grandchild home for winter break. He has never looked more pleased with himself. He is right to.

yale-law-school-1-4-zip.tagline: Navy quarter-zip with Yale Law School text and a small shield crest. Composed, persuasive, and appropriately understated.
yale-law-school-1-4-zip.story: A good argument is built like a good garment: nothing loose, nothing extra, every seam with a purpose. This navy quarter-zip pullover would hold up under cross-examination. A stand collar. Ribbed cuffs and hem. Yale Law School text and a small shield crest on the left chest. It belongs in a seminar room where the reading was long and the debate is longer, and on a late walk home along Wall Street, still arguing a point in your head. You will win it. Eventually.

yale-maplehouse-diana-mockneck.tagline: Cream mockneck with a large blue outlined BULLDOGS across the chest. A soft-spoken silhouette, an unmistakable spirit.
yale-maplehouse-diana-mockneck.story: The mockneck is a garment of quiet sophistication. It suggests a ski lodge, a gallery opening, a long lunch in a city with good bread. This cream mockneck sweatshirt brings that sensibility to campus, then adds a twist: a large blue outlined BULLDOGS wordmark across the chest, bold and cheerful. Ribbed cuffs and hem. Wear it to brunch with something tailored. Wear it to a hockey game with a scarf. Elegance and school spirit, it turns out, have been friends all along.

yale-mom-crewneck.tagline: Heather gray crewneck, a large navy YALE with UNIVERSITY and MOM lettering. Every late-night phone call, finally rewarded.
yale-mom-crewneck.story: She read every draft of the application essay. She waited by the phone on decision day, pretending to be busy. She cried a little at drop-off and then, in the car, a lot. This heather gray long-sleeve crewneck sweatshirt is for her. A large navy YALE wordmark, UNIVERSITY beneath it, and MOM lettering on the chest. Wear it to the farmers market. Wear it to book club. Wear it whenever you like, really. You have earned the right to wear it anywhere.

yale-mom-hoodie.tagline: Navy hoodie with a white Yale University wordmark and MOM lettering. For the drive home, and every proud mile of it.
yale-mom-hoodie.story: The drive to New Haven is long. The drive home, after saying goodbye at the gate, feels longer. This navy blue pullover hoodie is good company for both. A white Yale University wordmark and MOM lettering across the chest. A drawstring hood for a nap at a rest stop. Long sleeves. A front kangaroo pocket for the phone, which will buzz eventually with a text that says, simply, I'm fine, love you. That text will make the whole drive worth it.

yale-sports-creqneck-field-hockey.tagline: Heather gray crewneck with large navy YALE, FIELD HOCKEY text, and an interlocking Y emblem. Autumn sidelines, fast sticks.
yale-sports-creqneck-field-hockey.story: Field hockey moves faster than the eye expects. A flick of the wrist, a ball skimming the turf, a goal before the crowd has finished standing up. It is a sport for quick minds and quicker feet. This heather gray long-sleeve crewneck sweatshirt pays tribute, with large navy YALE lettering, FIELD HOCKEY text, and a Yale interlocking Y emblem on the chest. Wear it on a crisp autumn afternoon at the field. Wear it afterward for cocoa and a full, enthusiastic replay.

yale-sports-crewneck-baseball.tagline: Heather gray crewneck, large navy YALE and BASEBALL lettering, a block Y beneath. For April games and cool evening innings.
yale-sports-crewneck-baseball.story: Early-season baseball is an exercise in optimism. The air is cold, the infield still damp, and everyone in the stands is convinced this is the year. I find it irresistible. This heather gray long-sleeve crewneck sweatshirt suits those chilly first games: large navy YALE and BASEBALL lettering across the chest, with a navy block Y emblem underneath. Pair it with a thermos. Pair it with a scorecard and a sharpened pencil. The seventh-inning stretch will feel especially good.

yale-sports-crewneck-golf.tagline: Heather gray crewneck with large navy YALE, GOLF beneath, and a Yale Y lettermark. For early tee times and long walks.
yale-sports-crewneck-golf.story: Golf is the only sport I know that is mostly walking and thinking, interrupted occasionally by a swing. The morning dew on the fairway. The flag far off, barely moving. A long silence before the putt. This heather gray long-sleeve crewneck sweatshirt suits that pace. Ribbed collar, cuffs, and waistband. Large navy YALE text, GOLF underneath, and a Yale Y lettermark on the front. Wear it for the early tee time. Wear it to the clubhouse after, telling the story of the one good shot.

yale-sports-crewneck-volleyball.tagline: Heather gray crewneck, navy YALE and VOLLEYBALL lettering, and a Yale Y. For the faithful in the bleachers, and on the court.
yale-sports-crewneck-volleyball.story: Indoor volleyball in the depths of winter is a small miracle. Outside, snow. Inside, bright lights and athletes leaping as if gravity were merely a suggestion. The crowd is close enough to hear the calls. This heather gray long-sleeve crewneck sweatshirt brings a little of that energy home: navy blue YALE and VOLLEYBALL lettering and a Yale Y emblem on the front. Wear it to the match. Wear it to class the next morning, still slightly hoarse from cheering.

yale-sports-hoodie-baseball.tagline: Heather gray hoodie with a navy YALE BASEBALL graphic and a Yale Y. For damp bleachers and rain delays worth waiting out.
yale-sports-hoodie-baseball.story: A rain delay is baseball's way of testing loyalty. Tarp on the infield. Umbrellas up in the stands. The true believers stay put, hoods raised, swapping stories about games long past. This heather gray long-sleeve pullover hoodie is for the believers. A drawstring hood, a front kangaroo pocket, and a navy YALE BASEBALL graphic with a Yale Y logo. When the tarp comes off and the players return, you will still be there, slightly damp and very glad you stayed.

yale-sports-hoodie-diving.tagline: Heather gray Yale Diving hoodie with navy collegiate lettering. Something warm for the moment you climb out of the pool.
yale-sports-hoodie-diving.story: Climbing out of the pool after a dive, the air always feels colder than it is. Wet hair. Bare feet on tile. A long walk to the bench. That is when you want this. A heather gray Yale Diving pullover hoodie with a drawstring hood, a front kangaroo pocket, ribbed cuffs and hem, and navy collegiate lettering. Pull it on between rounds. Pull the hood up as you wait for scores. Then wear it out into the evening, chlorine and pride in equal measure.

yale-sports-hoodie-golf.tagline: Heather gray Yale Golf hoodie, navy collegiate lettering. For brisk mornings on the course and the long walk to the green.
yale-sports-hoodie-golf.story: The best rounds of golf begin in a light fog, when the course is still asleep and the only sound is your own footsteps on wet grass. It is cold, briefly, before the sun burns through. This heather gray Yale Golf pullover hoodie is meant for those first holes. A front kangaroo pocket for tees and a scorecard. A drawstring hood. Ribbed cuffs and hem. Navy collegiate lettering. By the back nine you may take it off. By evening you will want it back.

yale-sports-hoodie-hockey.tagline: Heather gray hoodie with a navy YALE and HOCKEY graphic and a Yale Y. For the rink, the stands, and the ride home.
yale-sports-hoodie-hockey.story: The rink is cold. Everyone knows the rink is cold. Somehow everyone forgets, every single time, and arrives underdressed. Do not be everyone. This heather gray Yale Hockey pullover hoodie comes prepared: a navy collegiate-style YALE and HOCKEY graphic, a Yale Y emblem, a drawstring hood, long sleeves, and a front kangaroo pocket for hands numb from clapping. Wear it for the opening faceoff. Wear it through overtime, should the evening be so generous. Some are.

yale-sports-hoodie-soccer.tagline: Heather gray hoodie, navy YALE SOCCER lettering, and an interlocking Yale Y. For cold touchlines and warm celebrations.
yale-sports-hoodie-soccer.story: Autumn soccer has its own soundtrack. Studs on turf. A coach's sharp whistle. The low murmur of a crowd that knows something is about to happen. Then it happens, and nobody is murmuring anymore. This heather gray pullover hoodie belongs in that crowd: a front kangaroo pocket, a drawstring hood, navy YALE SOCCER lettering, and an interlocking Yale Y logo. Wear it on the touchline. Wear it to the pizza place afterward. New Haven has a few of those, I am told.

yale-sports-hoodie-swimming.tagline: Heather gray hoodie, navy YALE SWIMMING lettering and a Yale Y. For early practices, long laps, and the walk home after.
yale-sports-hoodie-swimming.story: Swimmers keep the strangest hours. Up before the sun, in the water before breakfast, counting laps while the rest of the city sleeps. Then out again, hair still damp, into the cold morning air. This heather gray pullover hoodie is for that walk. A drawstring hood, a kangaroo pocket, ribbed cuffs and hem, and navy YALE SWIMMING lettering with a Yale Y logo on the front. Pull it on. Grab a bagel. Feel, for a moment, entirely superior to everyone still in bed.

yale-sports-hoodie-tennis.tagline: Heather gray hoodie with navy Yale Tennis graphics across the chest. Warm-up, cool-down, and every rally in between.
yale-sports-hoodie-tennis.story: Tennis players are creatures of routine. The same bounce before the serve. The same towel between points. The same hoodie, pulled on the instant the match ends. This could be that hoodie. Heather gray, with a drawstring hood, a front kangaroo pocket, ribbed cuffs and hem, and navy Yale Tennis graphics across the chest. Wear it for warm-ups on a chilly morning. Wear it afterward on the bench, replaying the tiebreak. Superstition is allowed. So is comfort.

yale-sports-t-shirt-field-hockey.tagline: Heather gray tee with large navy YALE, FIELD HOCKEY text, and a Yale Y. Summer training, autumn glory.
yale-sports-t-shirt-field-hockey.story: Before the autumn season comes the summer: early practices, warm mornings, drills repeated until they become instinct. Nobody sees that part. Everybody sees the result. This heather gray short-sleeve Yale sports T-shirt honors both, with large navy YALE lettering, FIELD HOCKEY text, and a Yale Y emblem on the front. Wear it for training. Wear it under a jacket on game day. Wear it long after your playing days, when you still instinctively look for the open pass.

yale-uncle-hoodie.tagline: Navy hoodie with a large white Yale University Uncle graphic. For the uncle with the best stories and the worst jokes.
yale-uncle-hoodie.story: Every family needs an uncle. The one who teaches you card tricks, remembers every birthday, and tells the same three jokes with undiminished delight. When his niece or nephew lands in New Haven, he will want to tell the world. This navy pullover hoodie lets him: a large white Yale University Uncle graphic across the chest, a drawstring hood, and a kangaroo pocket for, presumably, more card tricks. Expect him to wear it to every family gathering. Expect the jokes, too.
